title: P2 proof error: existential witnesses wrongly confined to G_{n0}; rho is not an automorphism of A

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Unjustified — and false — confinement of existential witnesses in the proof of P2.**

In Lemma `lem:P2`, from $\A\models\phi_i(\bar c,x_0,y_0)$ with $x_0,y_0\in G_{n_0}$, the proof applies the reflection $\rho=\rho_{n_0,\bar c}$ of Prop. `prop:K3` and concludes $\A\models\phi_i(\bar c,\rho x_0,\rho y_0)$ (eq. (4)). The sole justification (parenthetical, after eq. (4)) is:

> "The witnesses of the existential $\phi_i$ verifying (2) may be taken inside the $P$-connected component of $x_0,y_0$, i.e. inside $G_{n_0}$ ..."

This is asserted without proof and is **false**. $\phi_i$ is an arbitrary existential formula in the *full* language including the spine $R$ and the anchor $D$. Its witnesses may travel along $R$ out of $G_{n_0}$ — e.g. via an $R$-path of length $n_0$ to $G_0$ — and read the **directed** orientation supplied by $D$ on $G_0$ (this is exactly how $\mathrm{Base}_{n_0}$ works in the P1 proof). Confining witnesses to the $P$-component fails precisely because $R$ provides connectivity transverse to $P$.

**Compounding error:** $\rho$ is an automorphism only of the *induced substructure* on $\bar c\cup G_{n_0}$ (where the $R$-edges incident to $G_{n_0}$ have been deleted because $G_{n_0\pm1}\cap\bar c=\varnothing$), **not** of $\A$. Numerically verified on a finite model ($n_0=2$): $\rho$ breaks 48 of the $R$-edges between $G_1,G_2,G_3$. An existential formula is preserved by $\rho$ only if the *entire* witnessing assignment lies inside the substructure where $\rho$ is an automorphism; since witnesses can leave $G_{n_0}$ via $R$, the step (2)$\to$(4) is invalid.

Propositions `prop:K3` and `prop:K4` inherit the same defect: they reason inside the truncated substructure $\bar c\cup G_{n_0}$ (spine removed) and then transport the conclusion to $\A$, where the spine is present and *does* orient $G_{n_0}$ from $G_0$.

**What a correct P2 would need:** an honest preservation lemma producing an automorphism of the *full* $\A$ (or a $\bar c$-fixing self-embedding) that reverses the action on the relevant gadget. The present $\A$ (with $\AUT(\A)\cong\Z$, no reflections at all) admits no such map, which is the structural reason P2 is in fact false here (see the contradiction issue).
